sources.entry: Vane - AI-powered search engine (alternative to Perplexity AI). MIT Docker
Vane (formerly Perplexica) | AI-powered answer engine, an open-source alternative to Perplexity

summary.one_liner: Vane is a self-hostable, privacy-focused AI answering engine (formerly Perplexica) that searches the web via SearxNG and returns answers with cited sources, using local or cloud LLMs.
summary.what_it_does: Vane is a web application that answers user questions by searching the internet and summarizing results with cited sources. It uses SearxNG as its bundled metasearch backend, and lets users pick web, discussion, or academic sources, plus image and video search. Users can connect local LLMs through Ollama or Lemonade, or cloud providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and Groq, and choose between speed, balanced, and quality modes. It also supports uploading files (PDFs, text, images) to ask questions about them, restricting searches to specific domains, widgets for quick lookups, and locally saved search history. The README also describes a search suggestions feature, a Discover page, and an API for developers.
use_cases: self-hosted alternative to Perplexity for private answers
running AI-powered web search with a local LLM via Ollama
asking questions about uploaded PDFs or documents
academic or technical research with cited sources
adding a custom AI search shortcut to a browser
integrating AI search into apps through its API
how_to_run: docker run -d -p 3000:3000 -e SEARXNG_API_URL= -v vane-data:/home/vane/data --name vane itzcrazykns1337/vane:slim-latest (use an existing SearxNG with JSON format and Wolfram Alpha enabled)
git clone the repository and run: docker build -t vane . && docker run -d -p 3000:3000 -v vane-data:/home/vane/data --name vane vane
Non-Docker: install SearxNG (JSON format and Wolfram Alpha enabled), then git clone, npm i, npm run build, npm run start
Open the browser to the Vane URL and configure API keys, models and SearxNG URL in the setup screen
notable: Bundled SearxNG in the default Docker image, so no separate search backend is needed
Slim image variant for users who already run their own SearxNG instance
Works with local OpenAI-API-compatible servers as well as Ollama and cloud providers
Answers include cited sources, with speed, balanced, and quality search modes
Formerly named Perplexica, listed in awesome-selfhosted as an alternative to Perplexity AI
caveats: Requires a configured AI provider; local models need Ollama, Lemonade, or an OpenAI-compatible server reachable from the container, which often needs extra network setup
Authentication is listed as an upcoming feature, so there is no built-in login yet
Some features are described as coming soon, including Tavily and Exa search support and more integrations
